name: libxsmm-full512-w32-k-loop-counters
hypothesis: Change only the counter initialization, decrement and branch in Llibxsmm_478 and Llibxsmm_70c from X8 to W8. Each loop retains exactly 512 iterations, the original loads, pointer increments, four ordered FP32 FMOPA operations and pointer rewinds. This tests 32-bit loop control; performance is unknown. This change is absent from the supplied measured inventory. ABI, general-size fallback, tails, n<=0 behavior and complete license notices remain unchanged. No tools or tests were run. Compilation, full-GEMM correctness at tolerance 0.002 and fresh repeated paired measurements remain required under the fixed gates and unchanged power settings. Throughput above 1800 GFLOP/s is not established.
